RagShortTexts: Franks have different chiefs and warbands.

Variants.Content: Franks have different chiefs and warbands, with some serving in Rome. An office raises one family’s standing without placing every chief in one command.

Franks have different chiefs and warbands. Followers retain family ties; decisions about guards and distant service affect common participation. Individual Roman service does not place everyone in one command.
